title: Nexus Receipt Extension
description: Extends receipt.base.schema.json. Module-specific fields for the Nexus module.

query_type.description: The classified query type that determined traversal strategy.

domain.description: Topic, module area, or concept queried.

drawers_queried.description: Number of Memory drawers consulted during traversal.

relationships_found.description: Number of graph relationships surfaced in the response.

entities_traversed.description: Number of graph nodes visited during traversal.

response_path.description: Path to the structured response JSON. e.g. .wabblespec/nexus/response-<timestamp>.json

graph_freshness.description: Graph freshness state at query time. FRESH < 20 new drawers since build, AGING 20-50, STALE > 50.

entity_graph_used.description: True if entity-graph.json was consulted during traversal.
